formName: Step 9 - Co-Applicant Compose Email - Water Licence Application
formDescription: This popup lets the user compose, preview, and send a signature request email to a co-applicant. The email request is used to obtain co-applicant approval before the application can proceed. After the user previews the email, the page can display a generated email preview as read-only context.

EmailTo.title: Email:
EmailTo.description: The co-applicant email address that will receive the signature request.

PersonalMessage.title: Add a personal message:
PersonalMessage.description: Optional message to include in the co-applicant signature request email.

PreviewEmail.title: Preview Email
PreviewEmail.description: Previews the email request without sending it.

EmailPreview.title: Email Preview
EmailPreview.description: Displays the generated co-applicant signature request email preview after the user previews the email.

SendEmail.title: Send Email
SendEmail.description: Sends the co-applicant signature request email.

ReturnRT.title: Return to my application
ReturnRT.description: Returns the user to the application without sending an email.
